title: Unfrozen + phone ready
summary: P0 page-freeze fixed and the tested phone presentation is now in the actual YTIntel app.
discord_changes: P0 FIX: removed the auth refresh feedback loop that could make Chrome report Page Unresponsive.
Phone-first layout: readable fields, 44px touch controls, safe-area spacing and keyboard-aware navigation.
The tested mobile presentation is published to production instead of being left on a development branch.
changes: Stopped the ytintel:auth event from calling auth.refresh(), which emitted ytintel:auth again and could create an infinite refresh loop.
Auth events now repair visible UI state only; explicit refreshes remain bounded to startup/focus diagnostics.
Published the tested v0.33.1 phone presentation as v0.33.2 with cache-busted assets.
Added a dedicated responsive layer for phones and touch tablets.
Reflowed metrics and reports for small screens while keeping wide tables locally scrollable.
Set text-entry controls to mobile-safe sizing and primary touch targets to at least 44px.
Added keyboard-aware bottom navigation and visual-viewport handling.
Preserved Analyse, Competitors and Vault access on mobile.
Kept data, account permissions and existing analysis behavior unchanged.
known_limitations: API credit remains a separate blocker for real model-backed analysis quality; this release fixes app responsiveness and presentation.
Automated mobile checks are not a substitute for every physical iPhone/Android device configuration.
Script Studio remains a separate unfinished feature and is not claimed as live in this release.
why_it_matters: The product must stay responsive before any intelligence feature matters, and it should be genuinely usable from the phone Mitchell actually carries.
